graph_edge.subject: Atorvastatin
graph_edge.relation_definition: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
graph_edge.evidence_text:
You should not use atorvastatin if you are allergic to it.
You should not use atorvastatin if you have liver failure.
You should not use atorvastatin if you have cirrhosis.
To make sure atorvastatin is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
muscle pain or weakness;
diabetes;
stroke;
a thyroid disorder;
a habit of drinking more than 2 alcoholic beverages per day; or
kidney disease.
Atorvastatin can cause the breakdown of muscle tissue.
The breakdown of muscle tissue can lead to kidney failure.
This happens more often in women.
It happens more often in older adults.
It happens more often in people who have kidney disease.
It happens more often in people who have poorly controlled hypothyroidism.
Pregnancy:
Tell your healthcare professional if you are pregnant, or plan to become pregnant, or become pregnant.
Atorvastatin may harm your unborn baby.
If you become pregnant, stop taking atorvastatin and call your healthcare provider right away.
Breastfeeding:
Tell your healthcare professional if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed.

source_line: You should not use atorvastatin if you are allergic to it, or if you have liver failure or cirrhosis.

graph_edge.subject: Adderall XR
graph_edge.relation_definition: The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
graph_edge.evidence_text:
Taking Adderall during pregnancy can cause premature birth, low birth weight, or withdrawal symptoms in the newborn baby.
Tell your healthcare provider if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.
There is a pregnancy registry that collects information about the health of females exposed to Adderall and their babies.
Adderall passes into breast milk and may harm a nursing baby.
You should not breastfeed during treatment with Adderall.
Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed the baby during treatment.

source_line: Adderall passes into breast milk and may harm a nursing baby. You should not breastfeed during treatment with Adderall. Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed the baby during treatment.

graph_edge.subject: Metoprolol

graph_edge.evidence_text:
Carvedilol is a beta-blocker.
Beta-blockers affect the heart and circulation (blood flow through arteries and veins).
Carvedilol is used to treat heart failure and hypertension (high blood pressure).
It is also used after a heart attack that has caused your heart not to pump as well.
Carvedilol may also be used for purposes not listed in this medication guide.
Carvedilol is not approved for use by anyone younger than 18 years of age.

graph_edge.subject: Levocetirizine
graph_edge.relation_definition: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
graph_edge.evidence_text:
Cetirizine is a second generation antihistamine that reduces the natural chemical histamine in the body.
Histamine can produce symptoms of sneezing, itching, watery eyes, and runny nose.
Cetirizine is used to treat cold or allergy symptoms such as sneezing, itching, watery eyes, or runny nose.
Cetirizine is used to treat an allergic reaction.
Cetirizine treats itching caused by chronic urticaria.
Cetirizine treats swelling caused by chronic urticaria.
Chronic urticaria is also known as hives.
Cetirizine minimizes the symptoms of perennial allergic rhinitis.
Cetirizine eliminates the symptoms of perennial allergic rhinitis.
Cetirizine minimizes the symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis.
Cetirizine eliminates the symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis.
Cetirizine minimizes the symptoms of chronic idiopathic urticaria.
Cetirizine eliminates the symptoms of chronic idiopathic urticaria.
Cetirizine minimizes the symptoms of allergic asthma.
Cetirizine eliminates the symptoms of allergic asthma.
Cetirizine minimizes the symptoms of physical urticaria.

source_line: Cetirizine is a second generation antihistamine that reduces the natural chemical histamine in the body. Histamine can produce symptoms of sneezing, itching, watery eyes, and runny nose.
